stage: P2-51 passive R75/42-degree empty-basket delivery matrix
purpose: Quantify the only geometry that passed the realized-angle screen across the full material, tread and lateral-position matrix without selecting a convenient friction value.

criteria.name: nip_capture
criteria.rule: ball crosses launcher local X=-33 mm without plough

criteria.name: ski_takeoff
criteria.rule: ball clears the R75/42-degree ski tip toward -X

criteria.name: retained_empty_basket
criteria.rule: ball remains inside the empty basket with final mean speed <=0.25 m/s

criteria.name: lidar_margin
criteria.rule: highest ball top is at or below Z380, preserving 10 mm to LiDAR Z390

criteria.name: d5065_contact_current
criteria.rule: absolute current during ball-wheel contact <=20 A per motor

criteria.name: d5065_contact_torque
criteria.rule: absolute torque during ball-wheel contact <=0.62 N m per motor

criteria.name: forbidden_contact
criteria.rule: no ball or launcher contact with chassis, arch, camera or LiDAR

criteria.name: finite_state
criteria.rule: no NaN or Inf in telemetry

diagnostics_only: ramp speed loss inferred against nip exit
native DART empty-basket rebound is comparative; loaded ball-ball contact remains uncalibrated
